Muramasa's response was curt. She sounded wholly uninterested. In fact, she almost certainly was.

The metal echo of the sword-armor rang hard and cold as always. But somewhere inside it was a dullness, like fatigue.

en.html:
I could not stop the disappointment.

"The Silver Star is with Rokuhara": the clue left behind by the warrior Aoe had been the first to come close to the secret of the Silver Star's whereabouts. I had put great hope in it.

But even the vast Fudaraku Castle is not all of Rokuhara. From the Four Kubo administrations onward, the shogunate's institutions were scattered across the country.

If not Fudaraku, then one of those. That conclusion was a harvest of sorts, if one wished to call it that.

...Anyway, I persuaded myself.

ja.html:
落胆は禁じ得なかった。
『白銀星は六波羅に』――武者青江の残した手掛かり
は初めて銀星号の所在の秘密に近付くものだったのだ。
期待するところは大きかった。

　だが、壮大なる普陀楽城とて六波羅の全てではない。
　四大公方府を始め、幕府組織は各地に散在している。

　普陀楽ではないなら、そのいずれか――この判断が
収穫と言えば収穫には違いない。
　
　……兎も角も、俺は自分を納得させた。
